change.item: Corrected the About repair workflow alert semantics so pending repair decisions use a warning and green remains reserved for completed or successfully repaired states.
Added a central Audit and Repair workflow specification covering actions, statuses, colours, messages, translations and accessibility.

addition.item: Added reusable CBStats presentation configuration files with strict INI sections, administrator editing and key-by-key inline overrides.
Added CBStats value groups with inclusive numeric intervals and explicit non-contiguous value lists.
Added CBStats output=percentage for the share of a selected field value within the filtered population.
Added CBStats output=progress target=Number for capped progress towards a positive target.
Added reusable CBStats groupset files, inclusive upper-bound interval groups such as 13-, and article/API parity.
Added reusable CBStats INI title sets, a native Joomla manager, Debug warnings, a complete French department mapping and multilingual country examples.
Added editor-safe editorial Cards with visually editable H1-H6 headers for grouping free HTML, CBStats and CBList content with the shared Card presentation.
Added CBStats output=distinct for counting distinct non-empty field values after all existing filters.
Added shared CBList and CBStats Card-title formatting with h1–h6 and positive rem suffixes; Card titles now default to semantic h4 headings.
Added a hidden five-click animated piranha Easter egg to the About screen.
Added a multi-level State reset menu with inactive-state cleanup, a four-color base palette, view-state disabling and a Debug-only full reset for Super Users.
Added contextual State-tab indicators, precise hover explanations, a complete color legend and help for every state setting.
Added shared responsive Cards for CBList and CBStats, with six colours and optional 33%, 66% or full-row widths.
Added responsive Pie, Bar, Histogram, Line and Radar dimensions with strict width and height options.
Added CBList output=value for retrieving one filtered field value without an iframe.
Added concise CBList and CBStats guidance to the View API tab and complete public help manuals.
Added a configurable Backend View-tab pagination limit.
Added reusable Joomla-style menu controls with dynamic inheritance labels, per-menu themes and true override resets.
Added centralized pagination choices shared by component configuration, views, menus and frontend lists.
Added limit= to embedded CBList views, applied after access checks, filters and sorting and before pagination and export.
Added native DATE, DATETIME, INTEGER, DECIMAL and BOOLEAN controls and validation to direct Storage forms.
Added inline Storage field title, SQL type, size and required-state editing, backed by the 6.1.7.104 schema migration.
Added field and action allow-lists to embedded CBList views.
Added multi-column initial sorting to embedded CBList views via sort=/dir=.
Added a theme switcher to the admin preview banner, alongside the existing layout and colour-mode controls.
Added a CBList actions section to the frontend debug panel, listing which terms apply on each screen and whether each is currently allowed.

change.item: Aligned the data-set editor with Joomla: existing files show Close, while new copies retain Cancel.
Fixed the data-set editor toolbar so it shows Close after a successful save.
Fixed inactive Details and Edit template tabs so retained templates no longer show a warning indicator.
Fixed the States disable action so it clears state permissions together with the inactive state configuration.
Fixed CBStats data-set duplication for a selected custom file.
Replaced the unreleased CBList title option with labels using its title key, aligned with CBStats, without a compatibility alias.
Aligned CBList and CBStats title visibility: labels defines block and Card titles, while hide=title hides them.
Replaced the unreleased CBStats title and headers options with the unified labels option using title, category, value and total keys.
Made visual CBStats totals represent the sum of displayed results after grouping, sorting and limiting, including overlapping value groups.
Replaced the unreleased CBStats output=form_name syntax with output=view_name, which returns only the ContentBuilder NG view name.
Renamed the view classification label from Tag to Category throughout the administrator, frontend and menu settings.
Ordered CBStats outputs consistently by importance in article help, API help, validation guidance and OpenAPI.
Renamed the unreleased CBStats ranges and rangeset syntax to groups and groupset throughout the runtime, API, editor, help and documentation.
Made the CBStats groupset help directly identifiable and added a complete example plus the administrator data-set management path.
Fixed BreezingForms radio, checkbox and select defaults in CB Edit, including selected options whose submitted value is empty.
Clarified the Audit and Repair workflow so only successfully applied repairs are highlighted in green.
Completed and harmonized the public CBList, CBStats and CB/API help, using view ID 15 in examples.
Fixed the Edit-column Default/Modified indicator so native BreezingForms NG radio, checkbox and select types remain Default until ContentBuilder settings actually override them.
New views now enable Detail and Edit template locks by default.
Made the Export capability follow the same published lock and inactive-cross rendering as Detail and Edit.
Moved the type-specific Edit control into the compact display row to expose upload and template settings earlier.
Rebuilt View Help as a contextual manual that opens on the active tab and covers every main administrator workflow.
Moved Introduction and Article resets into contextual Actions, moved operational guidance into Help and compacted the expert Edit workflow.
Moved Detail and Edit template creation exclusively into contextual Actions and grouped their lock with display options.
Aligned Detail and Edit status symbols consistently above their baseline-aligned lock and reduced excess tab spacing.
Aligned Detail and Edit status symbols above their lock and automatically saved contextual Detail, Edit and State actions after one confirmation.
Kept New-record access independent when disabling Edit.
Moved Detail and Edit template locks beside their tab labels so status indicators remain unobstructed.
Added contextual Detail and Edit actions for display reset, template regeneration, frontend disabling and Debug-only full reset.
Restricted element bulk actions to the View tab.
Replaced the small Intro, Detail, Edit and State status dots with a green check, orange triangle or red cross, while leaving unconfigured features without a symbol.
New views now start with four published states in green, orange, yellow and red, followed by six clean unpublished states.
Centralized the active List View Data filter request contract and removed legacy hidden-filter vocabulary from runtime code.
Separated menu-level access restrictions from the Edit button displayed in List View.
Reorganized ContentBuilder menu parameters into clear native Joomla sections and placed List View menu types first.
Consolidated legacy numbered list layouts into the standard List View while retaining Cards, Compact Table and Tiles.
Replaced long list pagination with a compact shared layout showing the first, last and nearby pages without horizontal scrolling.
CBList and CBStats numeric options now require unquoted numeric syntax.
Enabled the repository-wide PSR-12 quality gate and modernized CBStats with strict PHP types.
Direct Storage synchronization now preserves unpublished elements and refreshes native controls when SQL field types change.

fix.item: Kept standalone CBStats percentage formatting language-independent.
Preserved values not selected by CBStats groups or groupset as individual categories.
Fixed the French Category label spacing and disabled data-set import while existing rows are selected.
Disabled CBStats data-set import while one or more existing rows are selected.
Synchronized legacy BreezingForms Edit elements stored as text with their native radio, checkbox or select type while preserving explicit ContentBuilder overrides.
Added read-only detection and conservative repair of ContentBuilder record rows whose BreezingForms source record no longer exists.
Hardened CBStats totals for BreezingForms NG sources by validating both the source record ID and form ID.
Prevented empty locked Detail and Edit templates from showing false warning or error states when no corresponding published fields are active.
Made every read-only frontend Edit field immediately identifiable with shared accessible styling and a translated status badge.
Fixed invalid table constructor PHPDoc annotations and replaced a PHP 8.5-deprecated cast.
Fixed Close Preview not closing script-opened Preview tabs in Firefox.
Fixed the View list-limit control not enabling Joomla's Save actions after its value changed.
Preserved selected ContentBuilder views during updates and menu override resets.
Fixed menu translations, encoded group values and inherited or custom list-limit labels.
Fixed the dynamic filter order label rendering as a raw language key in the Joomla Menu Item editor.
Fixed ContentBuilder List menu items reverting to the first published view after a component update.
Updated vulnerable Composer and npm development dependencies to patched compatible releases.
Escaped free-text list and template output to prevent stored cross-site scripting.
Fixed Storage field creation, required-state display, row saving, sorting, system-field publication and schema-audit regressions.
Preserved CBList field and action context across navigation, saves and record actions, and hardened action permission checks.
Fixed a fatal error on front-end list views caused by a missing import in the pagination layout.
Fixed embedded CBList views losing or inverting their sort= order when paging through results.
Fixed upgrading from a version that predates the field_size column aborting during the 6.1.7.104 schema migration.
Fixed some permission-denied messages rendering as untranslated raw keys on the front end.
Fixed the admin Audit panel's repair result message not scrolling into view.
